assertions.evidence: src/urgency.ts defines `urgency: { type: "score", ... criteria: ["1 — Low...", ... "5 — Critical..."] }`, which is an ordered score question and not a choice question.
rateIncident computes `urgency: Math.round(answer.score) + 1` and `sortScore: answer.score + 1` from the single returned score, and compareUrgency sorts on sortScore.
buildRequest sends `state: { incident: { service: report.service.trim(), text: report.text.trim() } }`, so service and text are separate named fields.
